title: Nine Storeys of Brick
subtitle: 校园建筑 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园建筑（生活与学习·学校与校园）
meta: 主题语境：校园建筑（生活与学习·学校与校园）　|　核心词汇：building　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 building 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my mother was sent to measure ① a building she could not enter, and she said the entering was the whole of the lesson. The ② building, meaning the block and not the school, was nine storeys high and was locked by whoever came last; a building, she said, is the only thing in a campus that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ building in that campus had the same stair, and the ④ building at the north, meaning the one the headmaster kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly. A building, my grandmother said, is nine parts brick and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the brick is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ building was the whole of the school, meaning the school it housed and not the block. The ⑥ building, meaning the school and not any of that, is the only thing in a town that everybody enters and nobody questions; a building, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a block and a school. She said the school is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ building had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the stair. The ⑧ building of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine storeys and eleven years of measuring; a building, she said, is either the one at the north or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ building I remember is the one at the north, which was rebuilt in 1973 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ building, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being entered; every building, she said, is a school that has agreed to look like a block. She said the school was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 楼房（指那栋楼本身，与学校相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure a building 丈量一栋楼
D. n. 楼房（指校园里每一栋）
E. n. 楼房（指北面那一栋）
F. n. 楼房（抽象：它容纳的那所学校）
G. n. 那所学校（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a building she could not enter
The building, meaning the block and not the school
building was the whole of the school
the building had become a photograph in a report
The building of the whole thing
A building, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: measure a building 意为“丈量一栋楼”，1953 年母亲被派去丈量一栋她进不去的楼。
building 意为“楼房”，指那栋楼本身而不是学校，高九层，由最后走的人锁门。
building 指校园里每一栋楼，每一栋都是同样的楼梯。
building 指北面那一栋（校长管的一栋），是唯一有人认真丈量过的。
building 意为“楼房”，抽象指它容纳的那所学校，父亲说 building 就是那所学校的全部。
building 为抽象用法，指那所学校本身，是镇上人人都进、却没人质疑的东西。
building 意为“建筑物、楼房”，到 1968 年这栋 building 成了报告里的一张照片。
building 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九层楼和十一年的丈量。
building 意为“楼房”，我记得的是北面那一栋，1973 年重建，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
building 为抽象总称，祖母说楼房是唯一会因为有人走进去而变好的东西。
